findings.description: check() now returns a list of problem strings, which is empty when the report is within policy. `if check(report, rates):` is therefore true exactly when there are violations. findings.suggestion: Approve only when the list is empty: `if not check(report, rates): report.status = Status.APPROVED else: report.status = Status.NEEDS_REVIEW`.
findings.title: decide() treats the list of violations as a pass/fail boolean, inverting approval
